comparison.objective: Tighten a started bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket engagement, torque control, and repeated short ratchet drive/return strokes.
comparison.success_condition: Bolt rotation and seating plus at least six effective cycles; excessive torque or integrity faults invalidate the run.
comparison.reason: Although both use a slender tool in constrained access, ratcheting tests cyclic torque transmission rather than simultaneous tang release and axial extraction.
